MedToken - Healthcare Software for Hospitals, Clinics, Labs, Scan Centers & Pharmacies

MedToken brings together a Hospital Management System (HMS), Clinic Management Software (CMS), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Radiology Management System (RMS) and Pharmacy Management Software (PMS) in one connected healthcare platform from India. Patients use the MedToken app to find healthcare providers and book appointments or tokens, while providers manage appointments, patient records, queues, billing and daily operations from one console.

Our solutions

  • Hospital Management System (HMS) - hospital workflows, billing, appointments, patient records and care operations.
  • Clinic Management Software (CMS) - appointments, patient records, token queues and day-to-day clinic operations.
  • Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) - samples, testing workflows, laboratory records and reporting.
  • Radiology Management System (RMS) - X-ray, CT, MRI and ultrasound worklists, scan images, radiology reports, critical alerts and report sharing with patients.
  • Pharmacy Management Software (PMS) - inventory, prescriptions, dispensing and pharmacy billing.

Console login and registration

Facilities sign in or register as Scan / Lab, Clinic, Hospital or Pharmacy from the Console Login and Register Facility menus.

Frequently asked questions

What is MedToken?

MedToken is a healthcare software platform with HMS, CMS, LIMS, RMS and PMS plus patient appointments, token generation and queue management.

Is MedToken related to the MedToken (MTN) cryptocurrency?

No. MedToken at www.medtoken.in is healthcare management software built by Devfyzo Soft and is unrelated to any cryptocurrency.
